title: Carrowmore Lake Walking Route

images.title: Looking down Carrowmore Lake by Oliver Dixon, CC BY-SA 2.0 <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0>, via Wikimedia Commons
images.caption: Looking down Carrowmore Lake. The lough is situated in the parishes of Belmullet, Kiltane and Kilcommon Erris, County Mayo between the villages of Bangor Erris and Barnatra at the southern end of Broadhaven Bay. The freshwater lake is over 4 miles (6 km) long and almost 3 miles (5 km) wide at its widest point.

images.title: Northern end of Carrowmore Lake by Oliver Dixon, CC BY-SA 2.0 <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0>, via Wikimedia Commons
images.caption: Northern end of Carrowmore Lake. Glencullen's two townlands line its eastern shore and Rathmorgan and the Knocknascollop mountains rise up along its western shores. Carrowmore is not a deep lake and it provides the drinking water for the whole of the Erris area. It is fed by the Carrowmore River and drains into the Owenmore River on its way to Blacksod Bay.

description: This walk or cycle takes you along Carrowmore Lake in County Mayo. You can pick up a quiet country lane named Lough Carrowmore Drive on the western side of the lake. The track is suitable for walkers or cyclists and provides excellent views over the lake to the surrounding countryside. The lake is located just north west of the village of Bangor Erris where you can pick up some refreshments and the long distance Bangor Trail.
